title: A pill on a button keeps the theme's button look

owner_note.text: The card plan's merge of the AI pills into one pill kind stops at buttons: on a button the theme's button look reads better than the pill style, so I left the six AI dashboard pages as they are and the merge waits. The alternative is to make those buttons wear the pill class too; say so and it is one small merge with shots.
